sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
g=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
COLS=(21,26,31,36,41)
def tstate(gg): return ''.join(gg[42][c] for c in COLS),''.join(gg[45][c] for c in COLS)
bar,stem=tstate(g)
def bits(s): return int(''.join('1' if ch=='B' else '0' for ch in s),2)
reached={'BBBBB','BBBww','BwBww','Bwwww','wBBBB','wwBBB','wwBwB','wwBww','wwwBB','wwwwB','wwwww'}
gray=[i^(i>>1) for i in range(32)]
def s2b(x): return ''.join('B' if (x>>i)&1 else 'w' for i in range(4,-1,-1))
# Phase 1: cleanup click (stem T1 B->w) then gray walk from wwBww collecting untested
clicks=[]
cb,cs=bits(bar),bits(stem)
# cleanup: flip stem idx0
cs^=1<<4; clicks.append((45,COLS[0])); 
# now clean at wwBww
pos=gray.index(cs); j=pos; got=0
while got<6:
    j=(j+1)%32
    X=gray[j]
    if s2b(X) not in reached:
        diff=cs^X
        i=diff.bit_length()-1
        clicks.append((42,COLS[i])); clicks.append((45,COLS[i]))
        cs=cb=X; got+=1
    else:
        cs=cb=X  # pass through reached state (no clicks needed? NO - must flip to get there!)
# BUG: passing through reached states still requires flips. Redo properly:
clicks=[]
cb,cs=bits(bar),bits(stem)
cs^=1<<4; clicks.append((45,COLS[0]))  # now clean wwBww
pos=gray.index(cs); j=pos; got=0; prev=cs
while got<6:
    j=(j+1)%32
    X=gray[j]
    diff=prev^X
    i=diff.bit_length()-1
    clicks.append((42,COLS[i])); clicks.append((45,COLS[i]))
    prev=X
    if s2b(X) not in reached: got+=1
# Phase 2: bar-only gray sweep (31 flips) from current bar
cb=bits(bar)
bpos=gray.index(cb); bj=bpos
for _ in range(31):
    bj=(bj+1)%32
    X=gray[bj]
    diff=cb^X
    i=diff.bit_length()-1
    clicks.append((42,COLS[i]))
    cb=X
# Phase 3: stem remainder (4 clicks = 2 flips)
cs=prev
spos=gray.index(cs); sj=spos
for _ in range(2):
    sj=(sj+1)%32
    X=gray[sj]
    diff=cs^X
    i=diff.bit_length()-1
    clicks.append((45,COLS[i]))
    cs=X
print('total clicks:',len(clicks))
# execute in chunks of 6
import json
done=False
for k in range(0,len(clicks),6):
    chunk=[{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c} for r,c in clicks[k:k+6]]
    res=action(chunk)
    r2=last_action_result
    flag=r2.get('done') or r2.get('game_over') or r2.get('level_completed') or r2.get('run_complete')
    gg=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    b,s=tstate(gg)
    print(k,'bar/stem:',b,s,'flag:',flag)
    if flag: done=True; break
result={'done':done,'executed':k+6 if done else len(clicks)}
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
